title: Enhancement:Add multi-asic support for test_gnmi_countersdb.py
author: veronica-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

As with `test_gnmi_countersdb.py` (see issue https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/15407) , multi-asic support is needed in gnmi for this test.

### Current Behavior

`test_gnmi_countersdb.py` does not work for multi-asic

### Proposed Behavior

Support in the gnmi helpers for multi-asic

comments.author: yxieca
comments.body:
@vaibhavhd can you triage this issue further?

The belief is that the test should read config db per ASIC on multi-ASIC platform. Might be more multi-ASIC adaptation like this required.

comments.author: vaibhavhd
comments.body: @veronica-arista  are you able to fix this? Reference fix is here - https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/15572
